title: 2025–2026 Iranian protests
summary: Demonstrations began on 28 December 2025 amid a collapse of the rial, inflation and shortages, and spread to more than two hundred cities — reported as the largest rising in Iran since 1979. The response was live fire, ordered according to the accounts at the highest level, and thousands of protesters are reported killed. The record's end date, February 2026, is the imported item's and marks where the reporting the atlas has reaches, not necessarily where the events do.
